title: Rav Huna Mar bar Avya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Chullin 47a, raising an objection to Rav Ashi and saying: “All these animals of the open field have it this way.” He is likewise mentioned there at 58b according to Dikdukei Soferim.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Chullin 47a concerns a lung lobe. The saved Vilna Rashi digital comment glosses ברייתא as animals grazing in the meadow, with an alternative “healthy and fat.” חיוי here means animals, not snakes; the translation follows the grazing interpretation while preserving Rashi’s alternative.

The William Davidson Chullin 47a passage names Rav Huna Mar bar Avya addressing Rav Ashi. The animals/healthy-and-fat alternatives are preserved in the Vilna Rashi comment. The additional 58b reading in Dikdukei Soferim is Hyman’s report; that apparatus has not been collated here.
